Ready Meals — Nutrition Tracking

Already have food? SeeFood allows you to snap a photo of your meal and instantly get nutrition insights. No barcode scanning, no manual input — just point, capture, and learn.

Whether you're managing calories, improving your diet, or staying mindful of what you eat, SeeFood makes tracking effortless.

How It Works

  1. Take a photo of your meal
  2. AI identifies the food and estimates portion size
  3. Instantly view calories and nutrition breakdown
  4. Track your daily intake over time
